candidate: CEC Tokyo No.2 Existing Operations at Sunshine 60

selected_locator.precision: Community-mapped reference point inside the named Sunshine 60 office tower, the host building for CEC Tokyo No.2. It is not a separately mapped data-center suite, floor, boundary or rack location. The point does not assert that the entire tower is a data center.
selected_locator.identity_review: CEC’s 2010 opening release identifies Tokyo No.2 as the acquired MEX data-center business in Ikebukuro, occupying three floors in a 60-story tower. The current CEC contracts index explicitly maps MEX service to Tokyo No.2. The original legacy MEX facility page names the installation environment as Ikebukuro Sunshine 60. OSM way314155355 independently names exactly Sunshine 60, and the property operator’s access illustration identifies the tower within the complex. No headquarters-only inference or general Sunshine City complex marker is used.
selected_locator.uncertainty_reason: The community geometry has no measured positional-accuracy statement. Decimal precision is not survey accuracy; the source polygon is used only to choose a host-building reference point.

derivation_review.operation: Arithmetic center of min/max longitude and latitude; point-in-polygon test confirms it falls within the named office-tower ring.
derivation_review.scope: Host-building locator only; no floor or suite geometry.
derivation_review.rights: OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL-1.0. Numeric point retains community-map attribution.
